name: Aftertaste
zombies_effect: Keep all your Perks after being revived.
doa4_effect: On your next death, you retain your shields and chickens.
short_description: Retain all perks after revive.

name: Kill Joy
zombies_effect: Spawns an Insta-Kill Power-Up.
doa4_effect: Activates Insta-Kill for 60 seconds. Bosses are unaffected.
short_description: Creates an Insta-Kill power-up instantly.

name: Cache Back
zombies_effect: Spawns a Max Ammo Power-Up.
doa4_effect: Grants a max-level Ray Gun with unlimited ammo for 15 seconds.
short_description: Spawns a Max Ammo immediately.

name: Temporal Gift
zombies_effect: The next time-based Power-Up you activate lasts longer.
doa4_effect: The next Power-Up lasts twice as long and can stack with Fate of Fortune.
short_description: Extends the duration of your next timed Power-Up.

name: Stock Option
zombies_effect: For 60 seconds, ammo is taken directly from your stockpile instead of your weapon’s magazine.
doa4_effect: Grants an Ammo pickup that increases your weapon level and prevents ammo drain for 15 seconds.
short_description: Ammo pulls from reserve instead of the magazine.

name: Anywhere But Here
zombies_effect: Instantly teleports you to a random location and releases a concussive blast that repels nearby zombies.
doa4_effect: Grants a chicken companion for five minutes. Can be activated once every ten minutes.
short_description: Instantly teleport and blast away nearby zombies.

name: Power Keg
zombies_effect: Spawns a Full Power Power-Up, instantly restoring your Field Upgrade.
doa4_effect: For 60 seconds, beneficial concussive waves periodically erupt at your location.
short_description: Spawns Full Power for instant Field Upgrade charge.

name: Tactical Diffusion
zombies_effect: The next Nuke Power-Up you activate does not explode and instead grants all players 2000 Essence.
doa4_effect: For the next 90 seconds, each Nuke used (up to three) grants $2,000 for the Slayer Mart.
short_description: Disables the next Nuke and converts it into bonus Essence.

name: Arsenal Accelerator
zombies_effect: For 5 minutes, your Field Upgrade charges significantly faster.
doa4_effect: Deploys three Energy Mines within 30 seconds.
short_description: Speeds up Field Upgrade charge rate.

name: Shields Up
zombies_effect: Refills your armor and doubles its strength for 3 minutes.
doa4_effect: Grants a Barrel & Sawblade item lasting five minutes or until replaced or death.
short_description: Refills armor and doubles its durability.

name: Requipment
zombies_effect: For 5 minutes, your Equipment slots automatically refill over time.
doa4_effect: Grants a random combination of four Nukes and Boosts.
short_description: Your equipment slowly refills over time.

name: Power Vacuum
zombies_effect: For 5 minutes, kills have an increased chance to drop Power-Ups.
doa4_effect: For 5 minutes, enemies have a small chance to drop useful items on death.
short_description: Increases Power-Up drops from kills.

name: Respin Cycle
zombies_effect: Re-spins the Mystery Box weapon to one of equal or higher rarity after it settles.
doa4_effect: Awards either a helicopter or tank vehicle item.
short_description: Re-rolls settled Mystery Box weapon to same or higher rarity.

name: Dead Drop
zombies_effect: For 5 minutes, Salvage and Equipment drop rates are greatly increased.
doa4_effect: For 5 minutes, weapon drops occur roughly five times more often.
short_description: Boosts Salvage, Equipment, and drop frequency.

name: Who's Keeping Score?
zombies_effect: Spawns a Double Points Power-Up.
doa4_effect: For 5 minutes, treasure spawns at roughly five times the normal rate.
short_description: Instantly summons Double Points.

name: Free Fire
zombies_effect: For 60 seconds, firing weapons consumes no ammo. Does not affect Wonder Weapons or Underbarrel Launchers.
doa4_effect: For 60 seconds, firing weapons does not consume ammo.
short_description: Shoot freely for 60 seconds with no ammo cost.

name: Exit Strategy
zombies_effect: Immediately triggers an Exfil vote and reduces zombie spawns during Exfil.
doa4_effect: For 30 minutes, chicken eggs hatch extra coins.
short_description: Instantly start Exfil with reduced zombie spawns.

name: Profit Sharing
zombies_effect: For 2 minutes, a portion of the Essence you earn is shared with nearby teammates and vice versa.
doa4_effect: For 30 minutes, chicken eggs hatch additional cash shared evenly across all teammates.
short_description: Share Essence gains with teammates nearby.

name: Explosive Flourish
zombies_effect: For 2 minutes, reloading triggers an explosion around you that damages nearby enemies.
doa4_effect: Equips the player with a max-power RPG and grants unlimited ammo for 2 minutes.
short_description: Reloads trigger damaging explosions around you.

name: Soda Fountain
zombies_effect: The next Perk you buy grants an additional random Perk you don't already own.
doa4_effect: For up to 5 minutes, item spawns occur around four times more frequently.
short_description: Next perk purchase gives an extra random perk.

name: Nowhere But There
zombies_effect: Instantly teleport to a random downed teammate and instantly revive all nearby players.
doa4_effect: All players receive minimum respawn boosts and Nukes, downed players are revived, all Field Upgrades recharge, and Fate bonuses (Feet & Shield) are honored.
short_description: Teleport to a downed teammate and revive nearby allies.

name: Round Off
zombies_effect: Prevents rounds from advancing for two rounds after the next round transition.
doa4_effect: Ends the currently active round if under round 60. Has a 30-minute cooldown.
short_description: Stops round progression for two rounds.

name: Armor Gettin’
zombies_effect: Instantly grants a three-plate Armor Vest and full plates.
doa4_effect: Grants a one-plate Armor Vest with full plates, or if already equipped, awards a full refill of plates.
short_description: Instant full armor with a three-plate vest.

name: Idle Eyes
zombies_effect: For 30 seconds, all zombies ignore players and stand idle.
doa4_effect: All zombies ignore players and stand idle for 30 seconds.
short_description: Zombies ignore all players for 30 seconds.

name: Wall Power
zombies_effect: The next weapon purchased from a wall is automatically Pack-A-Punched.
doa4_effect: For one round, electric poles do not damage the player.
short_description: Next Wall Buy weapon comes Pack-A-Punched.

name: Flavor Hex
zombies_effect: Awards a random Ultra GobbleGum.
doa4_effect: Awards a random Ultra GobbleGum.
short_description: Grants a random Ultra GobbleGum.

name: Immolation Liquidation
zombies_effect: Spawns a Fire Sale Power-Up.
doa4_effect: For 5 minutes, Holy Brimstone rains down onto enemies.
short_description: Summons a Fire Sale instantly.

name: Support Group
zombies_effect: Grants ARC-XD, then Mangler Cannon, then Sentry Gun, then Disciple Injection in sequence.
doa4_effect: For 5 minutes, only Cymbal Monkeys spawn as items during arena gameplay. Other item types are unaffected.
short_description: Grants a sequence of powerful Support items: ARC-XD → Mangler Cannon → Sentry Gun → Disciple Injection.

name: Phoenix Up
zombies_effect: Instantly revives all teammates and allows them to keep all their Perks.
doa4_effect: Grants yourself and all teammates one extra life.
short_description: Revives all teammates instantly, preserving their Perks.

name: Modified Chaos
zombies_effect: Greatly reduces all Ammo Mod cooldowns for 1 minute.
doa4_effect: Greatly reduces all Ammo Mod cooldowns for 1 minute.
short_description: Greatly reduces all Ammo Mod cooldowns for 1 minute.
synergy: Elemental Pop (Chill Berry Augment), Ammo Mods

name: On the House
zombies_effect: Spawns a random Perk Power-Up that grants a free Perk to all players.
doa4_effect: Purchasing from the Slayer Mart grants one extra random item of any value.
short_description: Spawns a free random Perk for the whole team.

name: Wall to Wall Clearance
zombies_effect: For 30 seconds, all Wall Buy weapons cost only 10 Essence.
doa4_effect: For 2 minutes, a free Nuke deploys on your position every 10 seconds.
short_description: Wall Buys cost only 10 Essence for 30 seconds.

name: Crate Power
zombies_effect: The next weapon taken from the Mystery Box is automatically Pack-A-Punched.
doa4_effect: On your next death, you do not lose your gems.
short_description: Next Mystery Box pull becomes Pack-A-Punched.

name: Gift Card
zombies_effect: Instantly grants 30,000 Essence. Cannot be combined with other bonuses.
doa4_effect: Grants $30,000 to spend in the Slayer Mart.
short_description: Instantly gain 30,000 Essence.

name: Perkaholic
zombies_effect: Grants the player every available Perk instantly.
doa4_effect: Awards a random Field Upgrade, a random Ammo Mod, a Level 1 Armor Vest, and a 30-minute Chicken.
short_description: Instantly receive all available Perks.

name: Wonderbar!
zombies_effect: The next weapon taken from the Mystery Box is guaranteed to be a Wonder Weapon.
doa4_effect: For 30 minutes, at the start of each round, flip a coin to either become a Mutant or receive a Chicken.
short_description: Next Mystery Box pull becomes a Wonder Weapon.
synergy: Crate Power, Respin Cycle, Immolation Liquidation

name: Time Out
zombies_effect: For 3 minutes, all Normal and Special enemies are cleared, the round ends, and no new enemies spawn during the duration.
doa4_effect: For 30 minutes, within 30 seconds of each new Arena round, a free Nuke Bomb drops at your position.
short_description: Clears enemies and stops spawning for 3 minutes.
synergy: Crate Power, Hidden Power, Perk purchases, Der Wunderfizz routing

name: Near Death Experience
zombies_effect: For 3 minutes or up to 5 revives, players can revive or be revived instantly by standing near each other. Revived players retain all their Perks.
doa4_effect: For each Nuke dropped in the next 10 seconds, gain an extra life.
short_description: Instant proximity revives that preserve all Perks.
synergy: Phoenix Up, Shields Up, Revive-focused builds, High round boss fights

name: Reign Drops
zombies_effect: Spawns all core Power-Ups at once, including Insta-Kill, Max Ammo, Double Points, Full Armor, Random Perk, Fire Sale, Full Power, Bonus Points, and Nuke.
doa4_effect: At the next Slayer Mart store, all items have a random discount between 20% and 50%.
short_description: Instantly spawns every major Power-Up at once.
synergy: Main Quest steps, early-game setup, Fire Sale chains, survival emergencies

name: Hidden Power
zombies_effect: Instantly upgrades your currently held weapon to Legendary rarity.
doa4_effect: For 10 minutes, every weapon picked up has maximum power.
short_description: Instantly upgrades your current weapon to Legendary quality.
synergy: Wall Power, Perkaholic, early-game snowball, main quest prep

name: Newtonian Negation
zombies_effect: Zombies killed will float upward instead of falling normally.
doa4_effect: Same humorous effect applies.
short_description: Zombies float upward when killed.

name: Indiegestion
zombies_effect: Zombies release exaggerated flatulence effects when killed.
doa4_effect: Same humorous visual gag effect applies.
short_description: Zombies emit goofy flatulence effects when killed.

name: Rainburps
zombies_effect: Zombies belch sparkly rainbow bubbles upon death.
doa4_effect: Same humorous rainbow bubble effect applies.
short_description: Zombies release rainbow bubble bursts when killed.

name: Quacknarok
zombies_effect: Zombies wear rubber ducky inner tubes, adding a humorous visual twist.
doa4_effect: Same comedic appearance effect applies.
short_description: Zombies appear wearing rubber ducky float tubes.

name: Die Pitched
zombies_effect: Zombies emit high-pitched comedic voices as they approach and attack.
doa4_effect: Same humorous high-pitch voice effect applies.
short_description: Zombies speak and scream in high-pitched voices.

name: Holiday Cheer
zombies_effect: Zombies appear with festive decorations, adding a fun holiday-themed visual flair.
doa4_effect: Same festive cosmetic effect applies.
short_description: Gives zombies goofy holiday-themed decorations.
